name: BempsX-Nova
description: A high-performance, multi-device WhatsApp bot built on Baileys. Clean, modular, extensible.
author: BempsX-Nova

SESSION_ID.description: Secure authentication session string used to connect the bot to WhatsApp without QR scanning.

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Primary administrator WhatsApp number in international format (e.g. 2348012345678).

DATABASE_URL.description: Optional. MongoDB/Postgres/MySQL URI for persistent storage. Leave empty for local JSON.
